name: Color switch
goalName: Select color palettes for a light and dark mode on the website
goal: The colors used on a website is one of the first things the user notices. By selecting colors that raise are are associated with certain feelings / emotions, I might be able to steer the user's first impression. Websites often have a light and dark mode, which is why I want to choose two color palettes.
